description: This file defines the 'Action' class within the 'Opencart\System\Engine' namespace. It implements routing logic for executing controllers based on a route string, including handling for magic methods and registry management.

classes.name: Action
classes.description: Represents an action that encapsulates a route and method for executing a controller within OpenCart's engine.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Action with a route string, splitting it into route and method components.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the route string associated with this action.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the controller specified by the route, calling the specified method with arguments, utilizing the registry for controller instantiation and caching.
